_readme: Models and command access for a single-subscription setup (every agent runs a Claude model; no fallback to another provider). `exec` runs on the gateway machine in full mode: this gives the roles real command access to your computer, and the safety comes from the audit guard, the approval cards, the desktop lock and the rules, not from a sandbox. Read docs/en/safety.md before turning it on. Replace the model placeholders (for example the newest Opus and Sonnet your OpenClaw lists).
